# JoinOrder Q5a — European Theatrical Movies

```{tags} reference, query-template, joinorder
```

> [JoinOrder](../../join-order.md) benchmark · [all JoinOrder queries](index.md)

European theatrical movies from France production companies after 2005 (5 tables)

## Representative SQL

Rendered in the benchmark's native SQL with default parameters (no dialect translation available).

```sql
SELECT
  MIN(t.title) AS typical_european_movie
FROM company_type AS ct, info_type AS it, movie_companies AS mc, movie_info AS mi, title AS t
WHERE
  ct.kind = 'production companies'
  AND mc.note LIKE '%(theatrical)%'
  AND mc.note LIKE '%(France)%'
  AND mi.info IN (
    'Sweden',
    'Norway',
    'Germany',
    'Denmark',
    'Swedish',
    'Denish',
    'Norwegian',
    'German'
  )
  AND t.production_year > 2005
  AND t.id = mi.movie_id
  AND t.id = mc.movie_id
  AND mc.movie_id = mi.movie_id
  AND ct.id = mc.company_type_id
  AND it.id = mi.info_type_id
```
